'''Ins1dr''' was the user ID of a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] user who was active during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ins1dr posted a message on the [[Cularin holonet node]], claiming that the criminal [[Cris Tosiren|Sot-sirc]] had recently returned to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and that Sot-sirc had previously helped [[Len Markus]] to locate the [[Darkstaff]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]].<ref name="Insider">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lfinsider|text=Insider}}</ref>
